war_summary: War 139, day 104, conquest conditions not yet met (32 towns required, none captured). The front is sharply split: Colonials hold full or near-full control across many regions (AcrithiaHex, AllodsBightHex, AshFieldsHex, DeadLandsHex, FarranacCoastHex, etc.), while Wardens dominate others (BasinSionnachHex, ClansheadValleyHex, HowlCountyHex, ReachingTrailHex, ViperPitHex, etc.). The heaviest combat and ownership volatility is concentrated in a few contested corridors—EndlessShoreHex, CallahansPassageHex, ClahstraHex, OarbreakerHex, GodcroftsHex, and StemaLandingHex—where casualty rates are accelerating, enlistments are surging, and strategic bases are actively flipping between factions or falling neutral. Quieter regions show stable ownership with minimal events, confirming that strategic pressure and likely base ownership changes over the next 24 hours will be localized to these active zones.
